Integral Alexander duality, the full low skeleton, Hurewicz and Whitehead give the claimed wedge of S^(2n-4). Standalone verifier checked all pairs and ranks for n=4..40, and independent ordinary cut-complex mod-two chains n=4,5,6. The finite checks are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Completes the natural infinite parameter-three ordinary cut-complex topology of antipodally twisted circular ladder graphs proposed for investigation in 2026. Gives a uniform integral homotopy classification, nontrivial fully justified collapse, torsion exclusion and canonical Wagner boundary. The graph is nonisomorphic to the untwisted circular ladder despite coincident polynomial, and the statement is neither a textbook restatement nor an arbitrary finite calculation.
